title: setup silently turns off a project's AGENTS.md
what: In a project that has AGENTS.md and no CLAUDE.md, relay setup's CLAUDE.md skeleton imports it (`@AGENTS.md` on its first lines, as arsenal's CLAUDE.md:3 does), so the team's AGENTS.md keeps loading after setup; doctor flags a project whose AGENTS.md is neither imported nor loaded by the claude-md-and-agents-md setting.
why: 25 Oct, Claude Code docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md#agents-md, v2.1.277+; installed 2.1.310): AGENTS.md loads by itself only when no CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md exists in the start folder or above. relay setup writes both, so a project with only AGENTS.md (six Glonass repos have one, e.g. eis-adapter-worker) loses its team rules without a word. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: A temporary repo with AGENTS.md and no CLAUDE.md: after relay setup, CLAUDE.md has no @AGENTS.md line and CLAUDE.local.md exists, so Claude Code would skip AGENTS.md.
pass_cases: After setup CLAUDE.md imports @AGENTS.md; a project without AGENTS.md gets the skeleton unchanged; an existing CLAUDE.md is never rewritten (doctor reports the missing import instead).

fact: Edited where: folder entry named as a file (found 28 Oct, refuse-folder-and-pattern-entries-in-where)

said: Что касаемо использования сторонних проектов (в том числе миграция AGENTS.md) давай пока не будем их делать, составь список и предоставь его мне, после подтверждения мы понизим их приоритет до -1

question: Which queue items about using relay on other projects get ip -1 for now (the build of setup-silently-turns-off-a-project-s-agents-md was stopped on the owner's word, 30 Oct)?
